summary: M6 texture pass 2 (CONTRACT_M6 2.4) implemented: 6 new ambientCG-derived detail textures (Grass001, PaintedWood006C, Metal009, Plastic006, Moss002, Ground104), 6 new Surface values, PrimitiveKit.Lit gained a metallic argument, and a new PrimitiveKit.LitSurface(color, surface) gives Grass/Lacquer/Metal/Plastic/Foliage/Soil their own fixed, never-silently-shared finish (TextureLibrary.FinishOf) so they do not collide with unrelated uses of the same colour (this is what keeps the PRD 7.4 material caps holding). Applied: garden (Grass), player furniture (Lacquer, red-detected, both the procedural path and the Kenney-model path), office chair frame + lamp pole/base + robot shell (Metal), robot bumper (Plastic), potted-plant leaves and the fallen load's leaves/soil (Foliage/Soil), window pane (smoothness 0.95, no texture). Probe Step50a_/Step50b_ added; fixed 4 pre-existing PlayMode tests (ProbeTestsM42Look, ProbeTestsM3Models, ProbeTestsM4Levels, ProbeTestsM5House) whose hardcoded expectations the lacquer change invalidated. Full EditMode suite 448/448 green; full PlayMode suite 209/213 green, the 4 remaining failures are in ProbeTestsM5Levels (level10/level17 authored-route replays), a file and levels owned by the levels/audit agents who are concurrently reworking exactly those two levels per CONTRACT_M6 item 8 (git already showed level10.json/level17.json modified before I started); unrelated to materials/textures.
